ai.title: Community contract cuts leagues to three and adds prize and heat
ai.summary: The shared community contract in `common/src/community/contract.ts` reduces `COMMUNITY_LEAGUES` from five values to three, removing platinum and `diamond` and leaving `bronze`, `silver`, and `gold`. The comment notes that a league stored from before this change that is not in the list reads as the top one via `effectiveLeague`. The diff also adds an optional `heat` field to `CommunityPost`, an optional `rising` array to `CommunityFeed`, and a new `CommunityLeaguePrizes` type referenced by an optional `prizes` field on `CommunityLeagueBoard`.
ai.evidence: In `common/src/community/contract.ts`, the `COMMUNITY_LEAGUES` array was shortened from five values to three. The diff adds a `CommunityLeaguePrizes` type and an optional `prizes` field to `CommunityLeagueBoard`, and introduces an optional `heat` field on `CommunityPost` and `rising` on `CommunityFeed`.

eli5.text: The community leaderboard now has three skill levels instead of five, with the two highest tiers removed. To encourage competition, the top spots in each level can now win extra usage time as a prize, and new items in the community feed can be labeled as hot, rising, or new to show which ones are getting attention right now. These updates set the stage for how you see rankings and recommendations, but the prize amounts and label displays will appear only when the community section is fully active.
